02 / DESIGN PRINCIPLES

Built around freedom.

Premium exterior direction, but with practical engineering boundaries. These are design requirements — not features validated in the current CAD.

01 / OUTWARD CAMERAPROPOSED
REDMI 15

Open to the real world.

Keep the outward-facing phone back and cameras unobstructed for experimental hand tracking and improved passive cooling. Use edge retention and a separate optical light seal so outside light cannot reach the eyes.

02 / PURE IMMERSIONCOMFORT
◎

Light stays outside.

Removable face padding, a soft nose seal and a screen-side gasket. Any vents into the viewing chamber must be light-baffled.

03 / AUDIOWIRELESS
◖)))

No cable required.

Pair existing Bluetooth earbuds directly with the phone. No built-in speakers or headphone connector in the printed shell.

04 / SIMPLICITYOFF-GRID
⌁

Just your phone.

No battery, charging connector or USB-C cutout planned. Limit sessions for heat, battery and comfort; avoid covering device buttons.

03 / PRINTING & MATERIALS

Know the material.

Material quantities are computed from the original CAD solid volumes, not a slicer. Printing infill, walls, supports and waste must be calculated by your print shop.

SOLID-EQUIVALENT ESTIMATENOT A SLICER QUOTE
286g

Using 1.27 g/cm³ nominal PETG density, excluding the one-time fit gauge.

SOLID MODEL VOLUME225.06 cm³
PRINTED PIECES18 pieces

Not a final filament spool requirement or price. Sliced infill and supports alter mass substantially. A print shop should report actual grams, print time and total quote.

05 / DEVELOPMENT SEQUENCE

Concept first.
Print second.

No final CAD modification or commercial manufacturing should start until optical parts, phone measurements and the preferred open-back support strategy are approved.

01Approve exterior direction

Confirm the matte-black silhouette, open-back architecture, edge clamp concept, light seal and comfort goals.

02Buy and measure components

Document lens diameter, focal length, thickness, foam/strap dimensions and actual phone camera bump.

03Mechanical CAD revision

Engineer reliable adjustable retention, camera clearance, vent baffling, lens seats and strap anchors.

04Print fit samples

Use the lens gauge, cradle sample and real phone before committing to the full headset body.

05Calibrate and test

Evaluate optics, head tracking, heat, strap comfort, focus, durability and simulated use before any sales.
